name: Lune Salon & Med Spa
address: 7421 Melrose Avenue, Los Angeles, CA 90046. Street parking and a small lot behind the building.
hours: Tuesday to Saturday, 9 AM to 7 PM Pacific Time. Closed Sunday and Monday. This line answers around the clock.
deposit: Services of $100 or more need a $25 deposit to hold the time. We text a secure link to pay it; it comes off the bill at checkout. The assistant never takes card details on the phone.
cancellation: Free to cancel or move up to 24 hours before. Inside 24 hours, or a no-show, the deposit is kept.
medSpa: Injectables (Botox, dermal filler) are done by Noor Haddad, a registered nurse, under our medical director. New injectable clients start with a free 30-minute consultation; treatment is booked after it. Injectables are for clients 18 and over, and not during pregnancy or breastfeeding.
colour: New colour clients and big changes (going lighter, balayage on dark hair) get a quick patch test and consultation at the start of the appointment; no separate visit needed.
payments: Card, Apple Pay or cash at checkout. Gift cards are sold at the front desk and online.
policies: The assistant is an AI. It books, moves and cancels appointments and answers from this information only.
Prices for colour and injectables are starting prices; the stylist or nurse confirms the final price before starting.
The assistant never gives medical or skin advice; Noor covers that at the consultation.
